name: @fuaran-ui/wire-conformance-runner
description: Workspace-level cross-implementation wire-format conformance runner. Drives the TypeScript @fuaran-ui/ops codec over the wire-format-fixtures corpus and byte-diffs its canonical output against the F# canonical form (the committed corpus), failing loudly on any divergence. The other half of the gate — that the committed corpus is itself the current F# encoder's output — is asserted by the F# Fuaran.UI.JsonDecode.Tests suite (RoundTrip + Reject + SchemaConformance) run as the workflow's F# leg. See ../../fuaran-dotnet/docs/WIRE_FORMAT.md.
